faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DESO Almora GIS Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the DESO Almora GIS Technician position is 02-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the office before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the GIS Technician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the GIS Technician post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Remote Sensing and GIS or a PG Diploma in Remote Sensing & GIS to be eligible for the GIS Technician position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the GIS Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the GIS Technician post in the District Economics and Statistics Office Almora.

faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post or as instructed.
